mentions.name: Aevo
mentions.description: This app is a todos and notes web app with a new take on task management: every task can have nested subtasks layered as deep as the user wants, and a grouping feature helps surface what is really important right now and how big a task is. Tasks support notes, links, and files, and a Mac app is available; it is in active development and used daily for work.
mentions.problem: Most todo apps show a simple list, don't show what is really important right now or how big a task is, and handle subtasks and projects as separate (or absent) concepts.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on my very own Web App for Todos and notes. I wanted to take a real new take on todos, because most apps I used show a simple list and does not give me the option to see what is really important right now and how big a task is.
